name: Organización Soriana, S. A. B. de C. V.
summary: Organización Soriana, S. A. B. de C. V., together with its subsidiaries, operates various formats of stores and clubs in Mexico. The company's stores offer various food, clothing, general merchandise, and health products, as well as basic services for the home, under retail, medium wholesale, and wholesale schemes. It operates its stores under the Soriana Híper, Soriana Súper, Soriana Mercado, Soriana Market, Soriana Express, and City Club name. The company is also involved in real estate activities, such as leasing and management of commercial premises; and realization of commercial developments.
